The investigation traced seven entities linked to the seed wallet 0x8b85752cc9ae2fd426e0b52396e9856fb23b14eb, with a total of seven transfers recorded. Six transfers are confirmed and one inferred correlation was identified. The movement of funds shows a maximum depth of three hops from the seed address, with four transfers meeting or exceeding the 30 % reporting threshold and three remaining below that level. The seed wallet carries a risk score of 20 / 100, classified as low, reflecting proximity to a known scam cluster at hop depth zero. Two additional addresses—0x989e71bfb5ac158dc74806c2ea76f57dc2752091 and 0xe7487955bc48390f49de515c54cd2df63f4d6b18—also received a low risk score of 20 / 100.

The reported loss amounts to INR 1,85,000, incurred on 1 September 2026 at 11:04 IST. All observed fund movements are documented without attribution to any individual or entity, and no account holder has been identified as the source or recipient of the transferred amounts.
